BY_RENTER.TITLE: Cancellation by the renter
BY_RENTER.ITEM_1: The lessor specifies a time period during which the renter is eligible for a full refund of the paid amount if the cancellation occurs within this period.
BY_RENTER.ITEM_2: If the renter cancels the reservation after the end of the period mentioned above, they are entitled to a refund of only half of the amount.
BY_RENTER.ITEM_3: If the renter wishes to cancel after the start of the rental period, they are not entitled to any amount and must return the car immediately to the lessor.
BY_RENTER.ITEM_4: If the renter does not show up to collect the vehicle at the appointed time without informing the lessor within a grace period not exceeding two hours, the reservation is automatically cancelled and the renter is not entitled to any refund.

BY_LESSOR.TITLE: Cancellation by the lessor
BY_LESSOR.ITEM_1: The lessor has the right to cancel the reservation before the start of the rental period for a legitimate reason such as (but not limited to) establishing that the renter is not qualified or has provided incorrect information; this is subject to review and evaluation by Cruiz platform.
BY_LESSOR.ITEM_2: If the lessor cancels the reservation for illegitimate reasons or delays delivery for more than two hours, the renter is entitled to a full refund of the paid amount without any deduction, a fine of 1000 Saudi riyals is imposed on the lessor, and the Cruiz platform and the renter reserve the right to claim any additional compensation resulting from this breach.

MODIFICATION.TITLE: Modification
MODIFICATION.ITEM_1: A reservation modification can be requested before the start of the rental period, subject to the lessor's approval, and the platform may impose additional modification fees.

REFUND.TITLE: Refund
REFUND.ITEM_1: Refunds are processed through the same payment method used for the booking within a period not exceeding seven working days.
REFUND.ITEM_2: Refunds are applied according to the above clauses and depending on the cancellation status; otherwise, the user has no right to recover any amounts.

GENERAL_PROVISIONS.TITLE: General Provisions
GENERAL_PROVISIONS.ITEM_1: In the event of a dispute or a claim for a refund after cancellation, either party may submit a complaint through the application via the Cruise platform's customer service.
GENERAL_PROVISIONS.ITEM_2: If any user (lessor or renter) is late for the agreed time due to an error in registration or providing incorrect information, the Cruise platform bears no responsibility for this delay, and the other party is not held responsible or liable for any consequences arising from that.
GENERAL_PROVISIONS.ITEM_3: The Cruise platform reserves the right to review any request for a refund or cancellation and verify its validity before making a final decision.
GENERAL_PROVISIONS.ITEM_4: The penalties and additional fees set out in the fourth clause of the terms and conditions apply to all cases related to delays or breaches of obligations by the parties according to this policy.

PRIVACY_POLICY_PAGE.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY_PAGE.HEADER_P: Cruiz Platform is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. We dedicate our efforts to providing an exceptional experience through our website and application, while ensuring the confidentiality of your personal information and complying with all applicable laws and regulations.

INFORMATION_WE_COLLECT.TITLE: Information we collect
INFORMATION_WE_COLLECT.ITEM_1: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you contact us or use our services, such as your name, email address, phone number, address, personal ID or any necessary documents.
INFORMATION_WE_COLLECT.ITEM_2: We also collect non-personal information related to your use of the site to improve our services.

HOW_WE_USE_INFORMATION.TITLE: How we use the information
HOW_WE_USE_INFORMATION.ITEM_1: Your data is used to deliver our services, communicate with you about offers and updates, marketing, and improving your experience.
HOW_WE_USE_INFORMATION.ITEM_2: It also helps us conduct research and studies to improve our services.
HOW_WE_USE_INFORMATION.ITEM_3: We do not sell or rent your data to third parties.

DISCLOSURE_OF_INFORMATION.TITLE: Disclosure of information
DISCLOSURE_OF_INFORMATION.DESC: We may share your data with our partners or service providers within or outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for the purposes of providing services or legal compliance, while safeguarding your privacy and information security.

COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies
COOKIES.ITEM_1: We use tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and personalize content.
COOKIES.ITEM_2: You can configure your browser to accept or reject these files; however, this may affect some site functions.

YOUR_RIGHTS.TITLE: Your Rights and Access to Information
YOUR_RIGHTS.ITEM_1: You can request to view, update, or delete your personal data in accordance with regulations.
YOUR_RIGHTS.ITEM_2: Some data may be retained for certain periods for legal or operational reasons.

CHANGES.TITLE: Changes to the Privacy Policy
CHANGES.ITEM_1: We reserve the right to modify the privacy policy as needed.
CHANGES.ITEM_2: Any changes will be communicated to you through the platform.

Pursuant to this commitment, we present to you the terms and conditions governing the use of the application/website.
PREAMBLE.P2: Using this application/website constitutes express acceptance of all the provisions and conditions contained in this document. If you do not agree to any of these conditions, please refrain from using the application/website.
PREAMBLE.P3: For the purposes of these terms and conditions, the following terms have the meanings indicated next to each of them unless the context requires otherwise:
PREAMBLE.L1_DESC: refers to the Cruiz platform as the owner and operator of the application and website and the related services.
PREAMBLE.L2_DESC: any natural or legal person who uses the application and/or website to list vehicles for rent, rent them, or browse the content.
PREAMBLE.L3_DESC: the individual or company who registers a vehicle on the platform and offers it for rent, and is responsible for providing it at the agreed time and condition, while complying with all approved terms and policies.
PREAMBLE.L4_DESC: the individual or entity that books a vehicle through the platform and uses it during the agreed period, abiding by the applicable terms and policies.
PREAMBLE.L5_DESC: the process by which the renter selects an available vehicle for rent via the platform, pays the due amount, and receives confirmation from the lessor.
PREAMBLE.L6_DESC: all policies announced by Cruiz, including the privacy policy, the cancellation and refund policy, and any other policies related to the services.
PREAMBLE.L7_DESC: any car listed on the platform by the lessor for rental to the renter, in accordance with the regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the rules of the Cruiz platform.

GENERAL_ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.L1: That you have read, understood, and agreed to comply with all the terms and conditions stated in this document and any subsequent updates.
GENERAL_ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.L2: That you have full legal capacity to use the application and/or website and to enter into contracts and obligations under the regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
GENERAL_ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.L3: That you will use the platform only for legitimate purposes and not in violation of any law, regulation, or effective decision.
GENERAL_ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.L4: That you will not misuse the platform in any way, including but not limited to using misleading information, violating traffic regulations, damaging rented vehicles, or mistreating other users.
GENERAL_ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.L5: That you agree to the Privacy Policy, the Cancellation and Refund Policy, and any other policies adopted by the Cruiz platform within its services. These policies form an integral part of the terms of use and are binding upon you when using the platform.

CREATING_ACCOUNT.TITLE: Creating an Account
CREATING_ACCOUNT.L1_DESC: To use the services of the Cruiz platform, the user must create a personal account through the application or the website and provide accurate and complete information, including, for example: full name, mobile number, and email.
CREATING_ACCOUNT.L2_1: They are 21 years of age or older.
CREATING_ACCOUNT.L2_2: They have full legal capacity to enter into contracts under the regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
CREATING_ACCOUNT.L2_3: They are not legally prohibited from using or dealing with the platform.
CREATING_ACCOUNT.L3_DESC: The user commits to maintaining the accuracy and correctness of the information provided during registration and to update it immediately upon any change. The platform has the right to suspend or terminate the account if it finds any inaccurate or misleading information.
CREATING_ACCOUNT.L4: Users must update their data and documents continuously. If any document expires such as a driver's license, the account will be temporarily suspended until a new valid copy is provided.

LESSOR.TITLE: Use by the Lessor (Host)
LESSOR.P1: When listing a vehicle on the platform, the lessor must provide the following data and documents:
LESSOR.L1_DESC: make, manufacturer, model, year of manufacture, number of seats, color, transmission type, vehicle features, and insurance information.
LESSOR.L2_DESC: specify the car pick-up location, whether delivery is offered, allowed mileage, daily rental price, period allowed for cancellation without fees, and discount rate for weekly or monthly bookings.
LESSOR.L3_DESC: a main display photo, a front photo, a right-side photo, a rear photo, a left-side photo, a photo of the front seats, a photo of the back seats, and up to three optional additional photos.
LESSOR.L4_DESC: state whether the vehicle has any damage (yes/no). If there is minor damage that does not affect performance, the lessor must mention it when listing the vehicle and attach a photo of the damage.
LESSOR.L5_DESC: vehicle registration (proof of ownership), periodic technical inspection certificate if the car is more than three years old, and the vehicle insurance certificate.

RENTER.TITLE: Use by the Renter
RENTER.P1: When using the application or website, the renter must provide the following data and documents depending on their status:
RENTER.L1_DESC: name as on the national ID or residence card, date of birth, ID or residence number, a copy of the ID or residence permit, a valid driver's licence, and a personal photo.
RENTER.L2_DESC: name as on the passport, date of birth, passport number, a valid passport, a valid international driver's licence, and a personal photo.
RENTER.P2: Vehicle selection: The renter browses the vehicles listed on the application or website and chooses a suitable vehicle based on the type and specifications, the number of rental days required, and the vehicle's location.

DELIVERY.TITLE: Pick-Up and Delivery
DELIVERY.L1_DESC: The lessor must take recent and clear photos of the vehicle from all sides (other than the photos attached in the listing), include photos showing the odometer reading and fuel level (fuel must be full), ensure that the vehicle is clean and fit for use and has undergone necessary maintenance, and arrive at the time and place specified in the booking.
DELIVERY.L2_DESC: The renter must arrive at the time and place specified, take photos of the vehicle from all sides before receiving it—including the odometer and fuel level. The renter's acceptance of the vehicle constitutes an explicit acknowledgment that it is in good condition and free of damages not mentioned by the lessor.
DELIVERY.L3_DESC: The renter must return the vehicle at the specified time and place, pay any delay fees via the platform if the return time exceeds the schedule, return the vehicle with the same fuel level and technical condition as at pick-up, and take photos of the vehicle at return showing the odometer and fuel level.
DELIVERY.L4_DESC: The lessor must photograph the vehicle immediately upon receiving it via the application, showing any damages, additional mileage, or fuel shortage if any. No claim of damage or violations is accepted after completion of delivery and closing the order unless documented at this stage. The lessor's acceptance of the vehicle from the renter without reservation constitutes an explicit acknowledgment that the vehicle is in good condition and free from damages.

PENALTIES.TITLE: Penalties and Additional Fees
PENALTIES.P1: Penalties and additional fees apply when the renter or lessor breaches their obligations as outlined in the usage mechanism.

RENTER.TITLE: Penalties for the Renter
RENTER.L1_1: A grace period of 30 minutes is allowed beyond the scheduled pick-up time.
RENTER.L1_2: After the grace period, the lessor may impose a delay fee per hour; these fees must not exceed half the daily rental value if the vehicle is picked up later the same day.
RENTER.L1_3: If the delay exceeds two hours, the lessor may cancel the booking and calculate the cancellation fee according to the announced cancellation policy.
RENTER.L2_1: The renter must return the vehicle on time; a 30-minute grace period is allowed.
RENTER.L2_2: After the grace period, a delay fee is charged per hour, and a full extra day is charged if the delay exceeds two hours.
RENTER.L2_3: If the delay exceeds two hours, the case is considered a severe delay. The lessor or the platform may notify the authorities to recover the vehicle, and the renter bears all fees, fines, and compensation resulting from the delay. The rent for any extra day is charged at double the agreed daily rate in addition to any other fees according to the platform policy.
RENTER.L3_1: If the renter exceeds the allowed mileage, excess kilometer fees apply: SAR 1 per extra kilometer for the first 0-100 km; SAR 2 per kilometer for more than 100 km.
RENTER.L3_2: If the renter returns the vehicle with less fuel than at pick-up, a SAR 100 penalty is applied.

LESSOR.TITLE: Penalties for the Lessor
LESSOR.L1_1: A 30-minute grace period is allowed. After that, the renter may request a discount equal to 10 % of the daily rental value for each hour of delay, up to a maximum of half the daily rental value if the car is delivered on the same day.
LESSOR.L1_2: If the delay exceeds two hours, the renter may cancel the booking and receive a full refund, and the platform may collect a SAR 1,000 fine from the lessor for breaching their obligations.
LESSOR.L1_3: The lessor must deliver the vehicle in good, usable condition free of defects that affect safety. If the vehicle is delivered in a condition not matching the agreed specifications or with defects affecting use, the renter may cancel the booking and receive a full refund, and the platform may collect a SAR 1,000 fine from the lessor.
LESSOR.L2_DESC: A 30-minute grace period is allowed to collect the car at the end of the rental; after that, the renter may request a discount equal to 10 % of the daily rental value per hour, up to a maximum of half the daily rental value if the vehicle is collected the same day.

GENERAL.TITLE: General Provisions
GENERAL.L1: Penalties and fees are automatically deducted from amounts due to the breaching party or collected through the approved payment methods on the platform. If unpaid, the platform may pursue collection through the judicial authorities in Saudi Arabia.
GENERAL.L2: No penalties or additional fees are waived.
GENERAL.L3: The platform may update the penalty and fee schedule at any time, with users notified via the application or website.

BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.TITLE: Booking and Payment Terms
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L1_DESC: Users can view available vehicles and book them for suitable dates and options. Booking is confirmed only after the lessor accepts and the renter completes payment via the approved payment methods.
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L2_DESC: The amount due is collected in advance via electronic payment methods. The amount paid includes the rental value, platform commission, value-added tax, and any additional fees specified by the lessor (such as delivery service).
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L3_DESC: The Cruiz platform charges a fixed commission of 15 % on each successful booking, automatically deducted from the paid amount. The remaining amount is transferred to the lessor's account on the first day of the following month for rentals completed in the previous month. The platform may delay the transfer in case of a dispute or request for clarification. The platform provides detailed reports showing the booking, collected amounts, and deducted commission.
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L4_DESC: Electronic booking confirmation via the application constitutes a binding contract between the lessor and the renter. Communication between the parties is available within the platform only after the booking is accepted.
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L5_DESC: A booking can be extended or modified subject to car availability and the lessor's approval; otherwise, it cannot be extended or modified. Extension and modification are subject to additional fees.
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L6_DESC: The Cruiz platform is not a direct party to the contract between the renter and the lessor; it acts only as a broker to facilitate booking and payment. The platform assumes no direct responsibility for delays or damages caused by either party.
BOOKING_AND_PAYMENT.L7_DESC: A refundable security deposit must be paid to the company's account to cover any violations or damages. This amount is retained in the company's account for two weeks after the rental period ends. Comprehensive insurance is mandatory on all rented vehicles to cover potential losses and protect the lessor from compensation claims if an accident occurs.

RESPONSIBILITIES.TITLE: Responsibilities and Warranties
RESPONSIBILITIES.P1: The user bears full responsibility for their use of the application or website and for all activities through their account. Some specific obligations include:
RESPONSIBILITIES.L1_DESC: The lessor must ensure the vehicle's fitness and safety before delivery, including regular technical inspection, insurance, and cleanliness. The lessor must not list vehicles they do not legally own or have the right to rent. The lessor is responsible for any legal violation related to the vehicle outside the rental period. The lessor must photograph the car at pick-up and return.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L2_DESC: The renter must use the car for the agreed purpose without misuse, negligence, or illegal activities. They must comply with traffic laws and regulations when driving. The renter must notify the relevant authorities (traffic or Najm) in case of any accident or damage to the car and immediately inform the platform and the lessor. The renter must photograph the car at pick-up and return.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L3_DESC: Cruiz acts as a technical intermediary between lessors and renters and does not bear direct responsibility for implementing agreements between the parties. The platform does not guarantee continuous availability of vehicles, compliance with booking or rental terms, or the absence of damages, accidents, or technical malfunctions. The platform disclaims liability for any direct or indirect losses or damages arising from the use or inability to use the application, website, or vehicle.

INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY.TITLE: Intellectual Property
INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY.P1: All intellectual property rights related to Cruiz, including the trade name, trademark, logo, designs, texts, images, videos, user interface, source code, and databases, are the exclusive property of the platform and are protected under the intellectual property laws of Saudi Arabia and relevant international agreements.
INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY.L1: It is prohibited to copy, republish, distribute, modify, or create derivative works from any part of the platform's content without prior written consent from Cruiz.
INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY.L2: Users may use the application and/or website and their content for personal and legitimate purposes only, in accordance with the terms of use.
INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY.L3: Using the content for any commercial, advertising, or competitive purpose is prohibited without explicit written permission from the platform.

TERMINATION.TITLE: Termination or Suspension of the Account
TERMINATION.P1: Cruiz reserves the right to suspend, cancel, or restrict the user's account access, temporarily or permanently, at any time and without prior notice if it determines that the user has:
TERMINATION.L1_1: Violated any provision of these terms and conditions or any related policies.
TERMINATION.L1_2: Provided false or misleading information during registration or use of the platform.
TERMINATION.L1_3: Misused the platform or caused physical or moral damage to another user or to rented vehicles.
TERMINATION.L2_DESC: Users may request cancellation of their account at any time through account settings or by contacting customer service. Termination or suspension does not relieve the user from any financial or legal obligations incurred before the termination date.

DISPUTES.TITLE: Disputes
DISPUTES.P1: These terms and conditions, any related policies, and any dispute or claim arising from or related to the use of the Cruiz platform are subject to and interpreted according to the laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
DISPUTES.L1: If any provision conflicts with applicable laws or regulations, that provision shall be considered void only, without affecting the validity or continuation of the remaining terms and conditions.
DISPUTES.L2: The user and the platform will seek to resolve any dispute amicably; otherwise, the dispute will be referred to the competent judicial authorities in the city of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
DISPUTES.L3: Arabic is the official language for interpreting and applying these terms and conditions and for all legal procedures and correspondence related to this contract. In the event of any conflict or difference between the Arabic text and any text in another language, the Arabic text prevails.
DISPUTES.L4: Cruiz assumes no responsibility for any delay or failure in performance resulting from circumstances beyond reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, health crises, system or communication outages, or security or political events.
